note: NIDA has issued national IDs free of charge since 2013 (The Citizen, 11 June 2022, which reported a planned Sh20,000 renewal fee when the first ten-year cards expired). In February 2023 the Minister for Home Affairs announced that the cards would last indefinitely, the expiry date removed (The Citizen, 22 February 2023), so the card is kept as never expiring and no renewal is modelled. The age from which it is issued and the time weren't found.

sources.title: The Citizen (Tanzania), Tanzanians to part with Sh20,000 for renewal of national IDs (11 June 2022)
sources.said: As it has emerged, citizens will have to pay Sh20,000 each when renewing the National IDs, unlike the past when they were issued free of charge.

sources.title: The Citizen (Tanzania), Tanzania removes expiration date on national IDs (22 February 2023)
sources.said: Tanzania's national identity cards are set to last indefinitely after the government announced the removal of the expiration date.
